'''''Nature''{{'s}} 10''' is an annual [[listicle]] of ten "people who mattered" in science, produced by the scientific journal ''[[Nature (journal)|Nature]]''. Nominees have made a significant impact in science either for good or for bad.<ref name=n102018/><ref name=n102017/><REF>{{cite web|url=https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20181219_09/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181219230219/https://www3.nhk.or.jp/nhkworld/en/news/20181219_09/|url-status=dead|archive-date=December 19, 2018|title=Nature picks 10 scientists who mattered|website=nhk.or.jp|access-date=19 December 2018}}</REF> Reporters and editorial staff at ''Nature'' judge nominees to have had "a significant impact on the world, or their position in the world may have had an important impact on science".<ref name=n102018/> Short biographical profiles describe the people behind some of the year's most important discoveries and events. Alongside the ten, five "ones to watch" for the following year are also listed.<ref name=n102019>{{cite journal|last1=Cyranoski|first1=David|last2=Gaind|first2=Nisha|last3=Gibney|first3=Elizabeth|last4=Masood|first4=Ehsan|last5=Maxmen|first5=Amy|last6=Reardon|first6=Sara|last7=Schiermeier|first7=Quirin|last8=Tollefson|first8=Jeff|last9=Witze|first9=Alexandra|title=Nature's 10: Ten people who mattered in science in 2019|journal=Nature|volume=576|issue=7787|year=2019|pages=361–372|issn=0028-0836|doi=10.1038/d41586-019-03749-0|pmid=31848484|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref name=n102018/><ref name=n102017/><ref name=n102016/><ref name=n102015/><ref name=n102014/><ref name=n102013/><ref name=n102012/><ref name=n102011/>
